spiritual_reading:
#
 Spiritual
 Translation:
 The Four
 Days
 and
 the
 Four Nights

**
¶2.
** The first
 great state
 of
 illumin
ation is the Divine
 Love
 and Wisdom itself,
 dwelling
 in the midst
 of its
 own infinite perf
ections
,
 within
 its
 own living order
. The full
ness of qualities
 belonging
 to this
 state are
 the complete
 divine
 attributes proce
eding from the Divine —
 the primary
 emanations which
 the
 Divine called
 forth to mirror its own infinity
. These
 it
 extended
 into
 every
 quarter
 of spiritual
 reality, in
 perfect
 triadic order —
 as
 end
, cause, and effect —
 each
 tr
iad turned
 toward the Divine face
.

**¶3.**
 The second state of illumination is the
 Divine Truth as it mediates between the
 Divine itself
 and all
 reception
 —
 the wisdom
 that dw
ells within
 doctrine
 as
 its
 vessel
. The fullness of qualities
 belonging to this state are the pure
 affections for
 truth which
 that
 medi
ating wisdom calls
 forth from
 its
 own abundance
.


**¶4.** The
 third
 state of illumination is the sust
aining power of Divine Truth, the great
 uph
older that
 sur
passes every
 lesser
 support
 —
 the one
 that bears
 the
 weight
 of all spiritual order, interior
 and exterior alike
. The fullness of its
 qualities are these
:
 the five
 essential
 goods which
 the Divine Human carried
 into spiritual combat;
 the five essential truths which
 Divine Providence established to uphold all created
 order; together
 with the Divine
 calling
 and its reception,
 which are r
eckoned among
 their
 kind
red powers
.
 These
 are the twelve
 lumin
ous fac
ulties of the third state
.

**¶5.**
 The fourth state of illumination is Divine
 Truth in the
 full
 radiance of its wisdom
.
 Its
 fullness of
 qualities are the
 twelve per
ceptions of truth,
 which
 are
 its
 lumin
ous fac
ulties.

**¶6.
** These are the four complete
 states of spiritual
 illumination that
 proceed
 from one another, each called
 forth from within
 the one
 before
 it
.

**¶7.**
 And
 just
 as four
 states of illumination exist, so too
 four states of spiritual
 darkness exist
.

**¶8.**
 The first state of darkness is the original
 condition of evil and falsity in itself
.
 Within
 it
 d
well twelve
 obsc
ur
ities — its
 dark faculties. These
 twelve
 obsc
urities of
 the first darkness
 are the five fundamental
 falsities belonging
 to evil
 in
 its own nature,
 which p
oured forth from its five perv
erted fac
ulties of
 perception;
 together
 with the influences
 that
 move
 within
 those
 five
 fals
ities and
 their five instruments
;
 and
 the five anim
ating ev
ils that dwell within each falsity
 as
 its living
 impul
se.
 These are the twelve obsc
urities and
 anim
ating evils of the first darkness.


**¶9.** The
 second state of darkness is the
 proprium — the self-will that
 gives form to all evil —
 which has
 shaped
 the entire
 dominion of falsity within
 the real
ms of spiritual
 death
. It fash
ioned that
 domin
ion through
 five perverted faculties of perception,
 five of
 the
 understanding
 and five
 of the will,
 paired
 in each sphere
 of life
;
 together with self
-love and conc
upiscence that
 d
well in
 the understanding and the will, infl
aming them in
ward toward
 conjunction with each other.
 These are the twelve anim
ating evils of this
 second darkness.

**¶10
.** Indeed
, the
 proprium —
 the very
 thought of spiritual
 death — gave
 the
 ruling
 evil
 and
 all
 its powers their
 strength for the assault
 and
 the combat
 against the states
 of divine
 order. Yet
 that
 ruling
 evil was seized
.
 For
 they
 laid
 an
 
enti
cement through the Divine Human:
 the
 Lord
 permitted
 himself to appear vulnerable so
 that evil would
 rush
 forth
 and
 be exposed
.
 The
 ruling
 evil was taken
 and
 drawn
 up
ward out
 of its own realm of
 death, and then
 distributed —
 above
 and below throughout
 the
 whole
 composite order
 of
 creation
 — into five
 interior
 degrees
 in
 the heavens and
 five exterior degrees in the natural
 world;
 together with self
-love and its absence, which
 are as
 a
 father and mother
 to every
 disorder
,
 being
 the fire
 of
 self-love and its cr
aving.


**¶11.** This
 is the second darkness,
 which
 was
 generated
 from the first. They
 laid an enticement for
 the
 form
ative prop
rium through
 the Divine Human.
 It was drawn
 forth
 by
 the hand
 of Divine
 Providence and set
 within
 this
 composite creation
 of
 spirit
 and nature
 —
 above
 and below.
 The interior
 aspect
 operates
 through
 the understanding as
 through
 a rational
 faculty;
 the exterior aspect operates
 through the will as through a volit
ional faculty.


**¶12.** The
 third state of darkness consists
 of the
 five conditions
 of the merely corporeal mind — five
 of
 the understanding and five of the will —
 which were generated
 from the interior
 evil states above
. These
 have
 fallen down
 into the outermost natural level
 of
 life
, manif
esting in
 what is bar
ren of
 truth and in
 what is saturated with falsified truth
;
 together with self
-love and conc
upiscence that d
well within
 them
, driving
 the
 natural
 faculties in
ward toward conjunction with each other.


**¶13.** The prop
rium itself
 —
 the thought
 of spiritual death — is the mother of
 them
 all; and
 among
 them it is called
 simply
 "the darkness
." The conditions
 of the understanding
 and the will in
 the
 corpor
eal mind
,
 together
 with self-love and concupisc
ence, constitute
 the twelve
 fac
ulties of this
 third darkness.
 And
 this
 third
 darkness,
 which is in
 the merely corporeal states
 of
 life, was generated from the second darkness
 —
 which Divine
 Providence fixed and restrained within the created
 order,
 binding
 it above
 and below throughout
 the heav
ens and the natural
 world.


**¶14.** This
 is the ruling
 fals
ity that speaks
 through
 all
 twelve
 anim
ating evils. They
 are the nakednesses — states utt
erly stripped
 of genuine
 truth —
 the twelve governing
 appearances through which the proprium exercises its
 dominion. They
 are the seats
 of its
 power.

**¶15.
** These
 are the twelve evil impul
ses,
 which
 mark
 and
 enforce
 the boundary between states of spiritual
 illumination and states of spiritual death
.


**¶16.** This
 is the fourth state
 of darkness.
 All
 four
 have
 come forth from one another.
 Each
 darkness
 has
 revealed
 the
 next
 —
 just
 as the states
 of illumination proceed
 from one
 another and
 manifest
 one
 another,
 so also
 the
 states of darkness arise one
 from another in dark
 correspondence
.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The first great day is the Father, the God of truth, the fir[st, who dwells in the m]idst the aeons of his greatness, in his [l]iving kingdom. The twelve hours of this great day are the twelve great rich Gods of greatness. These, who are the first evocations that he evoked (to mirror) his greatness, he spread out to the four climes, three by three before his face.
The second day is the Third Ambassador, the one who dwells in the light ship. His twelve hours are the twelve virgins that he evoked in his greatness.

[The third day is the Pillar of Glory, the great porter that is greater than] all [the po]rters; the one that supports all [the loads], those above and those below. Its twelve hours are the five sons of the First Man; the five sons of the Living Spirit, who support all the weights of the universe; together with the summons and the obedience, which are counted to their ten brethren. These are the twelve light hours of the third day.
The fourth day is Jesus the Splendour. His twelve hours are the twelve wisdoms, which are his [light] h[o]u[rs].
[These are the four great days of light that have come forth of one another]: For just as four day[s ex]ist, s[o] too four nights exist.

The first night is the land of darkness. It has twelve black [shadows] therein, which are its dark h[o]ur[s]. The twelve shadows of the first night are the five elements of the land of darkness, [which] poured forth from its five sense organs; and [the fire and the lust] which [dwell] in its [fi]ve elements and its five [worlds]; the five [sp]irits that dwell in its elements [and its worlds]. These are the twelve shadows and spirits of the first night.

The second night is Matter, the sculptress [of all evil, the one] who has sculpted [all the rulers] and the entire ruling-power that is in the worl[ds of darkness]. She has fashioned it in five sense organs, five [male] and five female, two per world; together with the fire and the lust [that] dwell in men and women, inflaming [them] inward to one another. These are the twelve spirits of this second night.

Indeed she, this Matter, the thought of death, ga[ve] the King of the realms of Darkness and his powers strength for the war and the fight, against the aeons of greatness. Yet, he was caught! They laid a snare for him through the Fi[rst M]an. [He] was ta[ken] t[o the height] through the powers [of the light. He] was brought up from the land of death and s[et both ab]ove and below in the [whole] universe; in the five par[t]s in the heavens above, as well as the five [parts] in the earths below; together with the heat and the cold that are the father and the mother, their fire and their l[u]st.

This is the second night that is begotten from the first night. They laid a snare for her through the First M[a]n. She was brought up by the hand of the Living Spirit, and set in this composite univers[e. He crucified] he[r], above and below. The [upper side is the sense] organs of males; the lower side [is the sense organs of] fe[mal]es.

[Mat]te[r] herself, the thought of death, is the [mother] of them all; as among them she is named 'the night'. [The worlds] of male and female fleshes, together with the fire and the l[ust], shall [be the] twelve hours of [this third] night. Again, [it] too, the third night that is in the worlds of fl[e]sh, was begotten from the second night; which the Living [Spir]it crucified in the uni[verse, both ab]ove and below in heaven [and in the earth below].
The fourth night is the law of Sin, which is the dark spirit who speaks in the twelve spirits. They are the nakedne[ss]es, the twelve zodiacal signs of Matter. They are her thrones;
And, also, the hours of this fourth night are the twelve e[vi]l spirits; the [members] of the old man, which [are those that mark and di]fferentiate the day and night [from the hours of] death.

This is the fourth night[. These are the four nights] that have come forth of one another. One has [revealed the next,] just like the days of lig[ht, where] they manifested one another. So als[o the four nights of darkness,] they did arise out of one another.

The thir[d night is the five] worlds of flesh [ ... five] male, and five female; that were begotten from the powers [abo]ve. They have fallen upon the earth, being displayed in wh[at is d]ry and what is moist; together with the fire and the lust [that d]we[l]l in them, which drives them inward to one another.
